title: Computational Science and Numerical Methods
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the type of error analysis that we used at the beginning of this chapter."
Forward analysis is the type of error analysis that we used at the beginning of this chapter.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as effect on function by a variable's uncertainty (error)."
Propagation of error is defined as effect on function by a variable's uncertainty (error).

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most frequently used ―general-purpose‖ approximants for dealing with functions on bounded domains (finite intervals or finite sets of points)."
Polynomials are the most frequently used ―general-purpose‖ approximants for dealing with functions on bounded domains (finite intervals or finite sets of points).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in computers for representing numbers for human consumption, having uses for things such as memory addresses and error codes."
Hexadecimal is used in computers for representing numbers for human consumption, having uses for things such as memory addresses and error codes.
fib: ______ are the least squares problem and the interpolation problem, and the easiest space 𝜙 to work with the space of polynomials of a given degree.
The simplest approximation problems are the least squares problem and the interpolation problem, and the easiest space 𝜙 to work with the space of polynomials of a given degree.
______ refers to the problem of determining a function that exactly represents a collection of data.
Interpolation refers to the problem of determining a function that exactly represents a collection of data.
______ is an example of a potentially ill-conditioned function (of two variables).
Addition is an example of a potentially ill-conditioned function (of two variables).
